buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic While generating invoice in GeM portal, the seller must upload scanned copy of GST invoice and the screenshot of GST portal confirming payment of GST. 3. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted. 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 6. Certificates Material Test Certificate Should Be Sent Along with The Supply. The Material Will Be Checked by Buyer’s Lab & the Results of the Lab will be the Sole Criteria for Acceptance of the Item. 7. Certificates The bidder is required to upload, along with the bid, all relevant certificates such as BIS licence, type test certificate, approval certificates and other certificates as prescribed in the Product Specification given in the bid document. 8. Certificates To be eligible for award of contract, Bidder / OEM must possess following Certificates / Test Reports on the date of bid opening (to be uploaded with bid): TEST REPORT . 9. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS LAPTOP 1 Manufacturer Authorization Form: An OEM authorization certificate must be submitted on letter head o

f the manufacturer of the offered product endorsing with authorization to specific bid number. Also details such as name, designation, address, e-mail ID and Phone No. of OEM is required to be furnished along with the bid. The same could be confirmed from the OEM during the Technical evaluation stage whenever asked through the email. 2 Technical specification/ Data sheet of the offered product should be available in public domain (OEM w ebsite) with model name/ number. Also, declaration from OEMs authorized signatory to be submitted that t his information will not be change/ tempered post bid submission/ till warranty of the offered product. Web link of the offered product must be provided. 3 OEM and bidder should submit document of under taking comprehensive warranty at the time of biddi ng. 4 A declaration by the bidder on 100/- stamp paper must be uploaded that the participating firm has not been blacklisted for fraudulent practices with any Government departments/ agencies/ ministries or PSU’s as on submission date of the BID. 5 Land border declaration to be uploaded by bidder and OEM as per compliance of restriction under Rul e 144(xi) of GFR 2017. 6 Bidder is to upload a self-declaration with Subject “Acceptance to Buyer Added Specifications and addit ional terms and conditions” with an ink signed document on firm’s letter head along with seal/ stamp that mentioning that all the required certificates, buyer added additional specification parameters and buyer up loaded additional terms and conditions has been reviewed and accepted. 7 Bidder shall not quote the product whose end of life has been declared by the OEM and are not obsolet e in the market. Also the offered product must have residual market life of minimum 5 years. Declaration f rom the OEM for the same must upload. 8 Declaration from OEM that non refurbished material will be used in the supplied Desktop. 9 All parts of the laptop should bear authorized/ authenticated Serial No. of OEM and should be assembled using proper industry-standard. The parts in laptop shall not be glued or stick so that the machi ne shall be able to withstand hot and humid conditions. 10 The OEM/ bidders should have to ensure for statutory/ mandatory requirement such as BIS-CRS, ISI m arks, Eco mark etc. as per GOI notification issued from time to time. 11 Valid and up to date ISO: 9001, ISO: 14001, and 27001 certificate for bidder as well as OEM to be upl oaded at the time of bidding. 12 Warranty details of the product serial numbers should be reflected in their OEM portal and a warranty undertaking must be submitted on OEM letterhead at the time of technical bid. 13 Bidder should have online fault booking procedure with generation of docket no. for each fault within 24 hours and on-site visit by support engineer within 72 hours 14 Dedicated working contact no./ toll free numbers of the bidder and escalation matrix of both OEM and bidder must be submitted. Calls may be made to these numbers, if the numbers found to be dummy/ bogu s/ invalid/ fake the bid will be liable for rejection 15 OEM should have All India Toll-free number for services/ Customer care support. 16 Bidder must review the latest GeM GTC before applying for EMD exemption. 17 OEM/ bidder should have all India service support center and minimum 02 service centers in north ea st to cater after sales services. Documentary evidence in the form of electricity bills or rent agreements to be submitted as part of bid. 18 Bidder is to certify that SSD of M.2 NVME technology will be supplied. The same should reflect in the p ublicly available datasheet of quoted product. Any mismatch will lead to rejection during the TEC. 19 All the technical specification/ configurations/ feature should be pre-activated/ completed and checke d by OEM prior to deliver the consignments.

20 Bill of materials with part code of the quoted product on OEM letterhead should be attached with bid. 21 Every laptop must have a unique Product ID/ Number provided by OEM same should be reflected in B IOS. 22 Product to be registered with OEM website by bidder after delivery of consignment. 23 Joint PRI:- After delivery of consignments, A Joint PRI will be carried out at consignee location and a re presentative from the OEM/ bidder must be present. Intimation for the same will be given through the email. 24 Unserviceable SSD/ HDD will not be returned by buyer during warranty period due to security reasons , same to be replaced by new one SSD/ HDD. Declaration from the bidder /OEM for the same will be given t hrough the email. 25 Desktop Laptop required without operating systems. Windows 11 hardware compatibility certificate is required for the laptop from OEM. 26 The device must not have any wireless feature. In, inevitable circumstances facility to disable/ lock th e wireless feature must be provided by the bidder/ OEM. 27 Payment terms and conditions as latest GeM GTC. 28 Malicious code certificate must be submitted by OEM as per DPM 25. 29 Bidder must submit stamped and ink signed specifications and additional terms & conditions in respe ct of bid on letter head. . 10. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 11. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 12. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 13. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 14. Warranty Successful bidder will have to ensure that adequate number of dedicated technical service personals / engineers are designated / deployed for attending to the Service Request in a time bound manner and for ensuring Timely Servicing / rectification of defects during warranty period, as per Service level agreement indicated in the relevant clause of the bid.
